_about: UAE authorised-program register. An entry is only usable when status is 'active', verified_on is within 30 days, in_scope is filled in from the LIVE policy, and a copy of that policy is saved under policies/. Being UAE-based is never itself permission. Build an engine scope with: python3 scripts/uae_scope.py build <id>

programs.name: UAE National Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
rules: Register as a tester on the national VDP platform before any testing
Only entities and assets listed for you on the platform are in scope
Report to the platform within the timelines in the V1.0 policy PDF
programs.notes: Official route for UAE entities and critical systems. Read the V1.0 policy PDF on csc.gov.ae for safe-harbour terms and prohibited activities before activating.

programs.name: UAE National Bug Bounty Programme
programs.owner: UAE Cyber Security Council (with TDRA; pilot with Etisalat and du)
rules: Vetted researchers only; follow the rules of engagement issued with your invitation
programs.notes: Announced Aug 2021. Current status after the telecom pilot is unknown: confirm with the Council before relying on it. The policy_url is a news article, not a policy; replace it with the official rules once obtained.

programs.name: du / GISEC bug bounty events
rules: Only during the event window and only on the assets issued at the event
programs.notes: Event-based. Replace policy_url with the event's rules page when registering.

programs.name: noon Bug Bounty & Responsible Disclosure
programs.rewards: unknown until the policy is read
